doctrine: A finished story should use MULTIPLE media channels with craft, not lean on charts alone. Default to all five: chart, image, video, audio, interactive/map. Skip a channel only with a genuine, data-grounded reason recorded in designer.json media_decisions — and try the documented fallback first.

channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.video: If no native event/process, animate the strongest still with image2video (parallax/ambient motion) or generate a short scene/chapter-break clip. Almost every story has at least one image worth animating.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.audio: If no real track, sonify a key ranked/time sequence (in-browser Web Audio, synced to its chart); or embed a relevant real recording (interview, archival, anthem) when one exists.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.image: Generate atmospheric/metaphorical images even for abstract data (>=2-3); for visual subjects (places, people, sport, food, nature) aim for 4-6 and prefer real fetched photos.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.interactive_or_map: If no geography, use a guess-reveal, scrubber, before/after, sortable table or mini-demo on a key finding.

presenting_each_channel.image: Full-bleed for impact or framed in-column; consistent treatment (duotone/grade to theme); real photos for concrete subjects, generated for atmosphere/metaphor; always captioned; mark illustration vs real.
presenting_each_channel.video: Muted, loop, playsinline, with a poster; use as hero or chapter break; keep short (<=6s) and purposeful; pair with a caption.
presenting_each_channel.audio: Integrated, reader-controlled, never autoplay sound; sonification bound to its visual; always a visual fallback.
presenting_each_channel.chart: Themed tokens, annotated, highlight the key datum with --accent, tooltips with exact values; vary chart types across the page; no 3-in-a-row without a break.
presenting_each_channel.map: Dark/muted tiles, custom markers on the shared data scale, legend, popups; don't fake a map without real coordinates.
presenting_each_channel.instance: Embed real, oEmbed-verified Spotify/YouTube/audio that lets the reader experience a data point; framed and captioned; copy IDs verbatim from the detective's verified instances.

variety_rules: Vary which channel is the centerpiece from story to story.
Don't reuse the same teaser structure, audio-card pattern or chart rhythm every time.
Let the dataset choose the mix; richness should feel earned, never quota-filled or decorative.

richness_targets.visual_subject_datasets: 4-6 images (prefer real photos) + a video (or animated still) + an interactive/map + audio.
richness_targets.geographic_datasets: an interactive map is near-mandatory; add real place photos and a video/animated still.
richness_targets.abstract_or_statistical: 2-3 atmospheric images + a sonification + at least one interactive (guess-reveal/sortable); video via animated still if nothing else.
richness_targets._note: Targets, not quotas: if a channel would be fabricated or purely decorative, skip it with a recorded reason.
